outcome: Adverse pregnancy outcomes (including miscarriages and congenital anomalies)
cohort: 73 women with type 1 diabetes experiencing 145 pregnancies, patients of Diabetes Clinic of North Karelia hospital between 2000 and 2012
finding: Pregnancy planning in women with type 1 diabetes was associated with lower HbA1c levels, fewer congenital anomalies, and a reduced risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, independent of other risk factors.
mod_finding: Pregnancy planning in women with type 1 diabetes was associated with a reduced risk of Cesarean sections (OR 0.25, p = 0.021).
